command:
cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set -e \
  && echo '=== R6: tools/perf workspace member ===' \
  && grep -c 'tools/perf' Cargo.toml \
  && echo '=== R6: cargo check -p perf ===' \
  && cargo check -p perf 2>&1 | tail -8 \
  && echo '=== R6: cargo run -p perf produces JSON (release for speed via shared lockfile) ===' \
  && cargo run -p perf --quiet -- --duration 1 --output /tmp/perf-smoke.json 2>&1 | tail -3 \
  && echo '=== R6: JSON valid + has 5 measurements ===' \
  && node -e 'const d=require("/tmp/perf-smoke.json");if(!Array.isArray(d.measurements)||d.measurements.length!==5)throw new Error("bad measurements: "+JSON.stringify(d).slice(0,200));console.log("schema_version="+d.schema_version+" measurements="+d.measurements.length+" phase="+d.phase)' \
  && echo '=== R6: check-slo-measurements --strict on synthetic (should pass since synthetic < budget) ===' \
  && node scripts/check-slo-measurements.mjs /tmp/perf-smoke.json --strict 2>&1 | tail -15 \
  && echo '=== R6: docs updated ===' \
  && grep -c '8. Backend perf harness' docs/perf-test-plan.md \
  && grep -c 'Backend SLO measurement harness' docs/observability.md \
  && echo '=== R6: CI workflow first 5 lines ===' \
  && head -5 .github/workflows/perf.yml \
  && echo '=== R6: structural slo-budgets gate still passes (pre-existing) ===' \
  && node scripts/check-slo-budgets.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3 \
  && echo '=== Final git diff --stat (full) ===' \
  && git status --short | head -20 \
  && echo '---' \
  && git diff --stat | tail -15 \
  && echo '=== ALL R6 GATES OK ===' \
  && rm -f /tmp/perf-smoke.json
